scoring_note: Showdown Captain Mode: one game, 1 CPT at 1.5x salary and 1.5x points + 5 FLEX. Projections are the same recency-weighted DK-scoring means as Classic; kickers and DST use DK's own season average (marked). Lineups are an exact solve under the cap, not a heuristic, and each further lineup uses a different captain.
